faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Madurai (AIIMS Madurai) for project-based research positions under the Department of Health Research.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post announced in AIIMS Madurai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AIIMS Madurai has announced vacancies for the Research Associate-III post under advertisement number AIIMS-MDU/IRC/DHR/TRC/2026/01.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate-III position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for AIIMS Madurai Research Associate-III recruitment is 20 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for Research Associate-III?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a post graduate degree in Public Health (MPH), M.Pharm, M.Sc. Epidemiology, or M.Sc. Health Economics with 3 years of experience, or hold an MD/MS/MDS/Ph.D degree.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Research Associate-III post is 35 years as per the notification details.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Associate-III post will receive a monthly salary of Rs 67,000 along with an HRA of Rs 13,400 per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Madurai Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for the Research Associate-III position exclusively through online mode by filling out the designated Google form and submitting required documents.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for AIIMS Madurai Research Associate-III?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting of candidates based on eligibility, followed by document verification and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application links?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links to access the official notification PDF, online application form, and the official AIIMS Madurai website in the Important Links section above.
